Backend: 8 new V6.8 tests (test_iter41_v68.py) + 11 V6.7 regression all pass; broader regression of iter34/35/37/38/39/40/41 = 80 passed / 1 skipped. Frontend: 24/24 assertions pass — all 5 atelier sub-tabs render their distinct panes (workshop default, genesis with deep-link button, epic mounts EpicCampaignPanel, timeline mounts TimelinePanel with system-themed gold lozenge for besm-4e, references mounts ReferenceEditor); Codex tab has all 3 view buttons; chart-view renders codex-chart-geo + codex-chart-pillars with all 5 pillars (population, geography, magic, technology, history). critical_code_review_comments: AtelierTab.jsx is 608 lines — over the 700-line guideline still acceptable but the 5 sub-pane render blocks (lines 173-205) would slot cleanly into a sub-component if it grows.

TimelinePanel.jsx line 55 filters encounters as `n.type === encounter|set-piece` but the rest of the codebase uses `n.kind` (see CodexChartView.jsx line 46 which uses `n.type` too — consistent here, but the V6.7 NPC sheet generator on line 156 of test_iter40 uses `n.kind`). Worth grep-confirming codex nodes carry both `type` and `kind` fields, otherwise some encounters may not cluster.
TimelinePanel.jsx min-width 600px on inner flex (line 99) means the timeline stays a horizontal scroll on mobile (390px) — acceptable for GM-tool surface but worth a responsive note.

CodexChartView.jsx geo bucketing (line 46) only inspects nodes whose `type` is one of [location, region, place, biome] — npc/faction/quest nodes with biome metadata are skipped from the geo flow. That matches the spec's intent (geography-only flow at top) but flag it for future expansion.

cypher_suggest_anime_cr.py:99-106 fuzzy match is case-insensitive substring against name+summary only; description-only entries (no summary) fall back via the OR on line 87. Verified working but consider also matching against `genres` array for richer hits.

cypher_suggest_anime_cr.py generate-sheet endpoint (line 412) — `save=true` writes `stat_block` and `stat_block_threat_tier` but does NOT update `node.updated_at`; downstream sort-by-updated may miss recent stat-block edits.

CarryForward from V6.7: CharacterSheet.jsx:534 still uses non-existent localStorage key `tg_user_id` for ownership gate (forge-power-bundles card never renders). Not in V6.8 scope but blocks Feature #6b. Recommend swap to useAuth() hook.
